items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: There’s an Australian trumpet player, Bob Barnard? And I did a recording with him, less than two years ago in New York.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, that’s the other — yeah. There’s an Australian trumpet player, Bob Barnard? And I did a recording with him, less than two years ago in New York. I think that was on a Canadian label, oh I forgot the name of it, Sackville or something like that?
